newsitem.title: USA: Billionaire Harry Helmsley dies at 87.
newsitem.headline: Billionaire Harry Helmsley dies at 87.

text.p: Billionaire Harry Helmsley, one of the richest and most powerful businessman in New York City real estate, has died at the age of 87, a spokesman said Sunday.
Helmsley died Saturday afternoon at Memorial Hospital in Scottsdale, Ariz., of pneumonia, Howard Rubenstein, Helmsley's New York-based spokesman, said Sunday.
Helmsley's controversial wife, Leona, the self-proclaimed queen of a string of hotels the couple owned, was at his bedside when he died.
"My fairy tale is over. I lived a magical life with Harry," she said in a statement.
The real estate tycoon had been ill for some time and had been hospitalized for about one week, the spokesman said.
A private funeral service will be held, Rubenstein said. Details service will not be disclosed until after the burial, he said.
